title: Employee Bonus Thresholds
scenario: Find employees whose bonus increased every year for 3 consecutive years.
tableSchema: bonuses (emp_id INT, yr INT, amt INT)
hint: Check if current > lag1, lag1 > lag2.
correctQuery: SELECT emp_id FROM (SELECT emp_id, amt, LAG(amt) OVER(PARTITION BY emp_id ORDER BY yr) as l1, LAG(amt, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY emp_id ORDER BY yr) as l2 FROM bonuses) t WHERE amt > l1 AND l1 > l2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE bonuses (emp_id INT, yr INT, amt INT);
